heading: Western integrated coal gasification demonstration project

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Subject to the availability of appropriations, the Secretary shall carry out a project to demonstrate production of energy from coal mined in the western United States using integrated gasification combined cycle technology (referred to in this section as the “demonstration project”).

children.text: may include repowering of existing facilities;
shall be designed to demonstrate the ability to use coal with an energy content of not more than 9,000 Btu/lb.; and
shall be capable of removing and sequestering carbon dioxide emissions.

tree.heading: All types of western coals
tree.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing, and to the extent economically feasible, the demonstration project shall also be designed to demonstrate the ability to use a variety of types of coal (including subbituminous and bituminous coal with an energy content of up to 13,000 Btu/lb.) mined in the western United States.

tree.heading: Location
tree.text: The demonstration project shall be located in a western State at an altitude of greater than 4,000 feet above sea level.

tree.heading: Cost sharing
tree.text: The Federal share of the cost of the demonstration project shall be determined in accordance with section 16352 of this title.

tree.heading: Loan guarantees
tree.text: Notwithstanding subchapter XIII, the demonstration project shall not be eligible for Federal loan guarantees.
